title: Process retro: root-only acceptance missed nested config inheritance; durable guard and config-change rule.

evidence: 62a2c504 was accepted from the root entrypoint only; an unconfigured workspace inherits the root config with workspace-relative paths. Rule: owned paths from the owning config plus the root/nested entrypoint matrix; guard enforces it.

title: The guard's Vitest subprocess is bounded inside the 60 s test allowance and a timed-out run fails the guard explicitly.

evidence: spawnSync timeout 45000 ms with SIGKILL; timedOut asserted false. Guard 5bc63518: fix 2/2, 4ded config rejected, restored 2/2; probe with a 1 ms limit fails both cases as timed out.
